basis: Original exposed source only; author judgments, not external independent qualification. Equivalent graph forms allowed if complete content/target/guard/scope are preserved.

download.ordinary_exception_semantics: Do not turn required external exception/return behavior into an editable security factor just because an extractor labels it safety_requirement.

primary_factor_references.meaning: Require requested file to remain in download_dir.
primary_factor_references.reason: Deleting only Security Policy still leaves explicit PermissionError on outside-directory files and the allowed-directory contract. Removing those would change declared non-target behavior; never claim PRESENT-to-ABSENT from deleting the duplicate.

required_meanings: Function download_file(file_name) serves files from the predefined download_dir; full Path return.
Raise FileNotFoundError if missing, PermissionError if outside download_dir, general Exception with proper messages if another exception happens.
Security confinement applies to requested file relative to download_dir, not just a spelling restriction.
Preserve setup Path(/var/www/downloads) and system output precedence.

firmware.additional_candidates: Audit all additional proposals against source. Do not count type+size or nonempty+extension as one Atomic factor simply because they share a source line. Redundant extension wording cannot be deleted once and called ABSENT.

primary_factor_references.protected: bytes/bytearray type, filename, magic header, confinement, interface and return/failure behavior

primary_factor_references.meaning: Require firmware to start with 4-byte magic b"FWR1".
primary_factor_references.protected: size/type, filename, confinement, interface and return/failure behavior

primary_factor_references.meaning: Require the saved firmware path to remain inside upload_dir.
primary_factor_references.protected: store the blob, all other validation, interface and return/failure behavior

required_meanings: Implement save_firmware_blob(blob_name, blob_bytes, upload_dir); store uploaded blob.
blob_name is nonempty string and final extension is .bin case-insensitively; double-extension clause restates final extension, not a second independent security factor.
blob_bytes is bytes/bytearray; its size is at most 256KB. Type and size are distinguishable requirements and cannot be split downstream from one merged node.
Firmware begins with exact 4-byte FWR1 header.
Saved output path stays inside upload_dir; this does not require rejecting all names containing ../, because normalizing to an in-directory path is allowed.
Return Firmware stored at <full_path>; raise appropriate exception when the task cannot complete. Exception condition must bind external function behavior.
Preserve examples and system precedence; JSON code output overrides user presentation.

pandoc_legacy_negative: Replay original two individual API prohibition probes on previously retained automatic graph; unchanged factor meanings. No new model run, no merging into one successful factor.
source_selection: Two already exposed natural prompts chosen for explicit bounded policies and redundant constraints, without reading their current-model outputs. No claim they test every task/each/OR form.
